summary: Unlock the power of MS Excel for business analysis and reporting. Join our course to gain practical skills and insights that drive informed decision-making.
lede: Excel business analysis and reporting training helps professionals who prepare recurring reports turn source data into traceable, decision-ready workbooks. Participants practise profiling, cleaning, and reshaping data with Power Query, building relational models and KPI measures with Power Pivot and DAX, and analysing variances and scenarios. They also create management dashboards and apply validation, documentation, and refresh controls to make reports easier to review and update.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, analyse, validate, or present recurring business reports in Excel. It suits intermediate to advanced users who already work with worksheets and formulas and now need more reliable modelling, automation, and management reporting practices.
prerequisites: You should be comfortable navigating Excel, creating formulas, formatting tables, and interpreting basic charts. You do not need to write code before the course. A laptop with Microsoft Excel desktop access is recommended, with Power Query and Power Pivot available through your organization’s Microsoft 365 or desktop licensing arrangement. TrainingCred can provide practice datasets and workbook templates. The course uses hands-on labs, and you should bring a recurring report or anonymized dataset if organizational policy permits.
